verdict.rationale: Running a desktop OS on low-cost single-board computers is a fair question for a Linux distribution, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions ARM or aarch64 support, Raspberry Pi or other SBC images, or hardware requirements. The docs cover general desktop and developer tooling (containers, Boxes, package management), and the community items concern desktop environments and x86 hardware. None of it shows the product delivers this story.
